1) the use of a time-varying envelope input signal can improve the RF-DC conversion in a rectenna by up to 4 dB; 2) a rectifier with RCN can improve its efficiency and output voltage by up to 5 dB and 3 dB respectively, while maintaining the output voltage constant over a large input power range.
